checks.title: every mutating route handler is authorized
tests: the app's src/app is really walked
every mutating handler reaches authorize(...) or passes its exemption's gate
the app's own exemptions are well formed, collide with no framework entry, and are not stale

checks.title: real-mode auth forms sit under their provider
tests: the app's src/app is really walked
every page that reaches a real auth form sits under a layout that reaches RealAuthProviders

checks.title: i18n namespace partition
tests: FRAMEWORK and APP namespaces are disjoint
the framework catalog's top-level keys are exactly FRAMEWORK_NAMESPACES
the app catalog's top-level keys are exactly APP_NAMESPACES
the MERGED catalog's top-level keys are exactly FRAMEWORK ∪ APP

checks.title: message catalogs: en vs es
tests: the framework catalog has identical key sets and ICU placeholders
the MERGED catalog (framework + app) has identical key sets and ICU placeholders

checks.title: tenant isolation on pglite (framework + app migrations)
tests: the full RLS proof suite passes

checks.title: migration numbering and upgrade order
tests: every app migration is numbered ≥1001 and none shares a name with a framework one
applies a framework migration that arrives after app migrations already ran, to the same schema as a fresh database

checks.title: the app names every cluster-wide role its migrations create
tests: appRoles, where the app exports it, lists distinct role names the app may own
every role the app's migrations create is named in appRoles
every role appRoles names is created by the app's migrations
every role appRoles names is an ordinary role once the app's migrations ran
app_user is an ordinary role once the app's migrations ran

checks.title: registered demo presets
tests: describe only worlds the product could reach
use only operation kinds the registry defines
have a server half for every defined operation kind, and no server half without a definition
resolve their title and summary in BOTH catalogs
replay on the server host: every operation performed, every invite pending, every hold set, the viewpoint signed in

checks.title: every seam module the kit imports resolves
tests: through the exports map of the app's seam package, when it has one
from the kit's own code

checks.title: a non-superuser owner on real Postgres
tests: a non-superuser owner migrates, and switches to app_user inside withTenant
a non-superuser owner migrates where app_user already exists, and switches too

checks.title: tenant isolation on real Postgres
tests: the full RLS proof suite passes

checks.title: the app's tables over the RDS Data API transport (through the emulator)
tests: the full RLS proof suite passes through the Data API
a non-superuser owner migrates, and switches to app_user inside withTenant, through the Data API
